# Picante

> Picante Studio designs growth systems for brands in the US, Latin America, and Europe. Pulse is its software for local reputation on Google Maps.

## Pulse

Pulse is Picante Studio software that monitors a business's area on Google Maps, compares competitor ratings, reviews, and activity, and replies to reviews in the brand's voice.

It is for restaurant owners, retail and local services, and operations teams that run several locations in cities across the US and Latin America.

Pulse is not an ads agency. It does not run Meta ads, Google Ads, or e-commerce performance campaigns.

- Spanish landing: https://wearepicante.com/pulse
- English landing: https://wearepicante.com/en/pulse
- Spanish blog: https://wearepicante.com/pulse/blog
- English blog: https://wearepicante.com/en/pulse/blog

Pulse es el software de Picante Studio que monitorea la zona de un negocio en Google Maps, compara rating, reseñas y actividad de la competencia, y responde reseñas con el tono de la marca. Sirve a restaurantes, retail y operaciones con varios locales en ciudades de USA y LATAM. No es una agencia de anuncios.

## Picante Studio

Picante Studio is the growth agency that designs growth systems for brands that already sell in the US, Latin America, and Europe. It brings strategy, creativity, performance, and artificial intelligence into one team. The work is measured with a diagnostic, execution, and results.

Picante is not a shop for isolated ads or one-off assets. Pulse is its separate software for Google Maps reputation.

Picante Studio es la agencia de growth que diseña sistemas de crecimiento para marcas que ya venden en USA, LATAM y Europa. Junta estrategia, creatividad, performance e inteligencia artificial en un solo equipo. Pulse es el software aparte, para reputación en Google Maps.
